title: An integrable tangent field on a chart piece lifts to an integrable coefficient field c with DΦ·c = JΦ·(Y∘Φ)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, Ω ⊆ ℝⁿ open, and Φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P of class C¹, Lipschitz on Ω and κ-antilipschitz on Ω for some κ > 0. Let A ⊆ Φ(Ω) be Hⁿ-null-measurable and Y : ℝ^P → ℝ^P Hⁿ⌞A-integrable, such that for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ A and every w ∈ Ω with Φ(w) = x, Y(x) ∈ range DΦ(w). Put D := Ω ∩ Φ⁻¹(A) and JΦ(w) := √det(⟨DΦ(w)e_i, DΦ(w)e_j⟩)_{i,j<n}. Then there is c : ℝⁿ → ℝⁿ, Lⁿ-integrable on Ω, with c(w) = 0 for every w ∉ D and DΦ(w)c(w) = JΦ(w)·Y(Φ(w)) for Lⁿ-a.e. w ∈ D. Here Hⁿ = μHE[n] on ℝ^P, Lⁿ = volume on ℝⁿ, DΦ(w) = fderiv ℝ Φ w and e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl P) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (A : Set (Eucl P)) (Y : Eucl P → Eucl P), IsOpen Ω → ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → (∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzOnWith K Φ Ω) → (∃ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ w' ∈ Ω, κ * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ w - Φ w'‖) → A ⊆ Φ '' Ω → NullMeasurableSet A (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → IntegrableOn Y A (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict A), ∀ w ∈ Ω, Φ w = x → Y x ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ Φ w).toLinearMap) → ∃ c : Eucl n → Eucl n, IntegrableOn c Ω (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) ∧ (∀ w, w ∉ Ω ∩ Φ ⁻¹' A → c w = 0) ∧ ∀ᵐ w ∂((volume : Measure (Eucl n)).restrict (Ω ∩ Φ ⁻¹' A)), fderiv ℝ Φ w (c w) = Real.sqrt (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))).det • Y (Φ w)
